items.title: Charles Elgar Interview, 1958-05-27
items.q: He's in, he's in Sweden now with Sarah Vaughan. I had a card for him the other day.

ctx.x: The New Orleans fellas, you felt, had higher musicianship, higher quality training.

Oh, I'm not afraid to say that, by all means. Do you think they're in college? Oh, there are, and there are a number, of course. Now there is an evolution that's taking place now that I'm very happy over. That among the younger fellas who are in college now, you'd be surprised at the number of young people who are going in for the serious side of music. And they are meeting with great success and now that the field is broadening and that this prejudice is dying out, there are many, many openings that they are…
Is he a member of this local here?
